title: Enforcing promises through reliance
question: When does reliance make a promise enforceable?

steps.note: Forbearance is consideration; the law does not weigh benefit to the promisor.
A grandfather’s note enforced because the granddaughter quit her job in reliance.
A subcontractor’s bid is held open by the general contractor’s reliance.
A pension promise enforced through retirement in reliance.
Reliance damages for a promise not to terminate a distributorship.
Promissory estoppel enforces a source-confidentiality promise.
